def IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf [Monoid S] (v : ι → M) (f : M →* S) : Set ι :=
  {i | IsMulIndecomposable v {j | 1 < f (v j)} i}

@[to_additive]
lemma IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_one_lt [Monoid S] (v : ι → M) (f : M →* S) :
    IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f ⊆ {i | 1 < f (v i)} :=
  IsMulIndecomposable.subset _ _

@[to_additive]
lemma IsMulIndecomposable.inv_mem_baseOf_iff [InvolutiveInv ι]
    [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹) (f : G →* S) {i : ι} :
    i⁻¹ ∈ baseOf v f ↔ i ∈ baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f) := by
  simp only [baseOf, IsMulIndecomposable, mem_setOf_eq, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    invMonoidHom_apply, hv_inv, map_inv, one_lt_inv']
  refine and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ⟨fun h j hj k hk hi ↦ ?_, fun h j hj k hk hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa [hv_inv] using h j⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) k⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv])
      (by rw [hv_inv, hv_inv, ← mul_inv, hi])
  · simpa [hv_inv] using h j⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) k⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv])
      (by rw [hv_inv, hv_inv, ← mul_inv, ← hi, inv_inv])

@[to_additive]
lemma IsMulIndecomposable.image_baseOf_inv_comp_eq [InvolutiveInv ι]
    [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
    (f : G →* S) :
    v '' baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f) = (invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' baseOf v f := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i⁻¹, (inv_mem_baseOf_iff v hv_inv f).mpr hi, by simp [hv_inv]⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i⁻¹, (inv_mem_baseOf_iff v hv_inv f).mp (by simpa using hi), by simp [hv_inv]⟩
